Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def build_pattern(N, input_p, input_value, below_start=1):
    """Build pattern according to verified formulas"""
    center = N // 2
    grid = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    
    # Row 0: c = input_p
    grid[0][input_p] = input_value
    
    # Rows 1 to center-1: |c - input_p| == r
    for r in range(1, center):
        for c in range(N):
            if abs(c - input_p) == r:
                grid[r][c] = input_value
    
    # Center row: edges
    grid[center][0] = input_value
    grid[center][N-1] = input_value
    
    # Rows center+1 to N-1: alternating, starting from input_p-1
    for r in range(center + 1, N):
        k = r - center  # 1 = first row below, 2 = second, etc.
        if k % 2 == 1:  # odd: left side
            grid[r][input_p - 1] = below_start
        else:  # even: original column

    return grid
